title: Designer Specialist
jobDescription:
About Trafilea Trafilea is a Consumer Tech Platform for Transformative Brand Growth. We’re building the AI Growth Engine that powers the next generation of consumer brands. With over $1B+ in cumulative revenue, 12M+ customers, and 500+ talents across 19 countries, we combine technology, growth marketing, and operational excellence to scale purpose-driven, digitally native brands. We own and operate our own digitally native brands (not an agency), with presence in Walmart, Nordstrom, and Amazon, and a strong global D2C footprint. Why Trafilea We’re a tech-led e Commerce group scaling our own globally loved DTC brands, while helping ambitious talent grow just as fast. 🚀 We build and scale our own brands. 🦾 We invest in AI and automation like few others in e Com. 📈 We test fast, grow fast, and help you do the same. 🤝 Be part of a dynamic, diverse, and talented global team. 🌍 100% Remote, USD competitive salary, paid time off, and more. Job Responsibilities At Trafilea , design is not just about aesthetics
- it's about driving acquisition, conversion, and revenue. As a Creative Design Specialist for Acquisition, you'll take ownership of the performance creative ecosystem across paid channels, designing assets that directly impact how we capture the attention of new audiences and turn them into customers across our brands. You'll combine creativity, performance thinking, and AI-powered workflows to elevate how we attract, convert, and scale our customer base. Lead the design and execution of paid media creative (static, video, and UGC-style ads) from concept to delivery across Meta, Tik Tok, Google, and other acquisition channels Create high-performing assets for acquisition initiatives (ad creatives, landing pages, funnels) optimized for click-through and conversion Define and improve creative testing frameworks, design guidelines, and workflows that enable rapid iteration and volume for performance marketing Collaborate with paid media, data, and product teams to align creative with acquisition KPIs (CTR, hook rate, CPA, ROAS) Design conversion-focused landing pages with strong UI/UX principles to maximize new-customer conversion Generate innovative creative concepts and angles that improve top-of-funnel performance and lower acquisition costs Ensure brand consistency across all acquisition touchpoints while adapting to platform-native formats Provide feedback, coaching, and direction to elevate creative output and testing velocity AI-first mindset: advanced user of Gen AI models (GPT 2, Nano banana 2, etc). Requirements Background in graphic design, visual communication, or UI/UX, with 2+ years of experience designing for email marketing and retention-driven experiences. Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite, with hands-on experience building emails within an ESP (e.g., Klaviyo). Solid understanding of responsive email design and UI/UX principles applied to landing pages and collections. Ability to work within and maintain design systems and brand guidelines across multiple touchpoints. Comfortable reading engagement and conversion metrics (open rate, CTR, conversion) to inform design iteration. Strong collaboration skills, with experience partnering with marketing, data, and product teams. Attention to detail and ability to translate briefs into on-brand, high-performing creative under tight timelines. Experience in AI-powered design tools and automations to improve speed and scalability. Originally posted on Himalayas
